Uzbekistan's Ulugbek Rashitov, -68kg champion at Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024 and the first man to win two taekwondo titles at the Games, was suspended for two years for three whereabouts failures.
Rashitov's ineligibility runs from May 13, 2025 to May 12, 2027, ending before the 2028 Games; his results from February 3, 2025 until the suspension were annulled.
Thailand's Banlung Tubtimdang won the men's -68kg title at the 2025 World Championships in Wuxi, beating South Korea's Seong Yu-hyeon 7-1 in the deciding round.
Croatia's Matija Crep won bronze at -68kg at the 2025 World Championships.
South Korea's Kim Yu-jin won the women's -57kg gold at Paris 2024.
Brazil's Maria Clara Pacheco upset Kim Yu-jin 2-0 in the women's -57kg final at the 2025 World Championships, her Worlds debut.
Jordan's Fadia Khirfan, born in 2007, won -57kg bronze at the 2025 World Championships in her senior Worlds debut.

China's Luo Zongshi, 2022 world champion at -57kg, won bronze at the 2025 World Championships.
South Korea is historically the sport's most successful nation, and Kim's 2024 win was the second Korean title in two days in Paris.

Iran's Arian Salimi won men's +80kg gold at Paris 2024, beating Great Britain's Caden Cunningham in the final.

Laurin told RMC Sport the long suspension would inevitably affect her career; whether she can return before the 2028 Games depends on the suspension dates, which were not given in the report.
Uzbekistan's Svetlana Osipova, Paris 2024 +67kg silver medalist, was ranked No. 2 in World Taekwondo's November 2024 rankings.

facts: This session holds the quarterfinals and semifinals of the men's +80kg and women's +67kg heavyweight categories, the final day of the taekwondo program.
At Paris 2024 the men's +80kg and women's +67kg medal contests were both held on Saturday, 10 August 2024, at the Grand Palais.
France's Althea Laurin won the Paris 2024 women's +67kg gold after winning bronze at Tokyo 2020, making her the defending champion in this category.
Uzbekistan's Svetlana Osipova reached the Paris 2024 women's +67kg final and took silver after a 2-0 loss to Laurin.
South Korea's Lee Dabin won a Paris 2024 women's +67kg bronze through the repechage final, and the other bronze went to a fighter from Turkey.
Great Britain's Rebecca McGowan and Germany's Lorena Brandl also competed in the Paris 2024 women's +67kg medal rounds.
Iran's Arian Salimi won the Paris 2024 men's +80kg gold, defeating Great Britain's Caden Cunningham in the final.
Cote d'Ivoire's Cheick Sallah Cisse and Cuba's Rafael Alba shared bronze in the Paris 2024 men's +80kg event.
Semifinal losers drop into the bronze medal contests later the same day, while fighters beaten by the two finalists enter the repechage.
Whether the Paris 2024 heavyweight medalists will compete in 2028 has not been confirmed in the sources reviewed for this brief.

At Paris 2024 the heavyweight repechages and finals for both categories were held in one combined evening session at the Grand Palais on 10 August 2024.

facts: The women's individual triathlon on Saturday, July 15, 2028 at 7:30am is scheduled to award the first medals of the 2028 Games, the first time triathlon has opened the medal schedule since Sydney 2000.
The individual swim starts from the beach rather than a pontoon, only the second time this has happened at the Games after Rio 2016, with a 1,000m lap, a 25m beach run and a 500m second lap.

The 40km bike leg is eight 5km laps on the Venice bike path and neighborhood streets with two technical turnaround points, followed by a four-lap 10km run through the Venice canals area, using a single transition area beside the finish.
A World Triathlon T50 event on the 2028 course in Venice Beach is planned for July 2027.
Cassandre Beaugrand (FRA), the Paris 2024 champion, won all five of her WTCS starts in 2026, including the Pontevedra Grand Final on Sept 26, 2026, to claim her second world title.
In the 2026 WTCS London race, Beaugrand won in 56:06, five seconds ahead of Lisa Tertsch (GER) and 15 seconds ahead of Tilda Månsson (SWE), after catching early leader Taylor Knibb (USA).
Beaugrand had a difficult 2025 and did not finish the 2025 Wollongong Grand Final, where she and Beth Potter (GBR) had gone in tied for the series lead.
Beaugrand has also set French athletics records, including 30:52 for 10km on the road in April 2026 and marks at 5km, 5,000m and 3,000m.
Lisa Tertsch (GER), a mixed relay gold medalist at Paris 2024, won the 2025 Wollongong Grand Final and the 2025 world title, with Bianca Seregni (ITA) second and Emma Lombardi (FRA) third on the day.
In the final 2025 WTCS standings, Léonie Périault (FRA) was second and Paris 2024 bronze medalist Beth Potter (GBR) was third.
Rio 2016 champion Gwen Jorgensen (USA) trained in the water at Venice Beach in 2026 while preparing for a possible appearance at a home Games.
Day 1 of the 2028 Games is set to feature the most women's finals ever held on a single day, starting with the women's triathlon.

facts: The men's individual triathlon is scheduled for Sunday, July 16, 2028 at 7:30am at Venice Beach, the day after the women's race.

The race starts from the beach into the surf with a two-lap 1.5km swim, followed by an eight-lap 40km bike course with two technical turnarounds and a four-lap 10km run through the Venice canals area.

Paris 2024 champion Alex Yee (GBR) ran the 2025 London Marathon in 2:11:08 and then the Valencia Marathon in 2:06:38 in December 2025, which made him the second-fastest British man in history at the time.
Yee has said his main goal for this cycle is to be on the triathlon start line at the 2028 Games in Los Angeles.
Yee finished third at the 2026 WTCS Grand Final in Pontevedra, four seconds behind the winner, after starting the 10km run 50 seconds down.
Vasco Vilaça (POR) won the 2026 world title, taking WTCS wins in Samarkand and Alghero and finishing second in Pontevedra.
Matthew Hauser (AUS), the 2025 world champion, beat Vilaça in a sprint at the Pontevedra Grand Final on Sept 27, 2026, with both given 1:39:31, and won three WTCS races in 2026.
The 2026 WTCS overall podium was Vilaça, Hauser and Ricardo Batista (POR).
In the 2025 final WTCS standings, Miguel Hidalgo (BRA) was second and Vilaça was third behind Hauser.

Paris 2024 silver medalist Hayden Wilde (NZL) suffered a punctured lung, six broken ribs and a fractured scapula when he was hit by a truck while training in Japan in 2025, then returned to win the 2025 T100 world title.
Wilde won the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship in Nice in September 2026; whether he will target the 2028 short-course race has not been confirmed in the sources reviewed.
Paris 2024 bronze medalist Léo Bergère (FRA) did not appear on any 2026 WTCS podium listed in the sources reviewed.

facts: The mixed relay is the last triathlon medal event of the 2028 Games, scheduled for Thursday, July 20, 2028 at 8:00am at Venice Beach.
In 2028 the relay runs in women-men-women-men order, the reverse of the men-first order used at Paris 2024.
Each relay athlete completes one 350m swim lap from the shoreline, a 6.6km bike over two 3.3km laps and a 1.6km run over two 800m laps before handing off near the transition area.
All four legs finish at the same Venice Beach finish line used for the individual races.
Germany won the Paris 2024 mixed relay ahead of the United States and Great Britain, its first gold in the event.
Lisa Tertsch, part of Germany's Paris 2024 winning team, went on to win the 2025 individual world title.

Australia (Sophie Linn, Luke Willian, Emma Jeffcoat, Matthew Hauser) won the 2025 Mixed Relay World Championships in Hamburg in 1:16:52, three seconds ahead of France and seven seconds ahead of Germany.
Hauser started the anchor leg in Hamburg 20 seconds down and beat France's Dorian Coninx on the run, giving Australia its first mixed relay world title since 2017.

France's silver-medal team in Hamburg in 2025 was Léonie Périault, Yanis Seguin, Cassandre Beaugrand and Dorian Coninx; Germany's bronze-medal team was Tertsch, Lasse Nygaard Priester, Tanja Neubert and Henry Graf.
The United States, Paris 2024 silver medalists, finished eighth at the 2025 Mixed Relay World Championships with Taylor Spivey, Chase McQueen, Erika Ackerlund and John Reed.
Great Britain, the Paris 2024 bronze medalists, finished fourth at the 2025 Mixed Relay World Championships.
Relay contenders will draw from individual medal hopefuls such as 2026 world champions Cassandre Beaugrand (FRA) and Vasco Vilaça (POR), Hauser (AUS) and Alex Yee (GBR).

facts: Table tennis will have six medal events at the 2028 Games: men's and women's singles, men's and women's doubles, mixed doubles, and a new mixed team event.
The ITTF's qualification system for the 2028 Games was approved by the IOC Executive Board and published in February 2026, and qualification officially begins in 2027.
Paris 2024 mixed doubles: China won gold, North Korea (DPR Korea) silver, and South Korea bronze.
China's Wang Chuqin and Sun Yingsha won their third straight world mixed doubles title at the 2025 World Championships in Doha, beating Japan's Maharu Yoshimura and Satsuki Odo 3-1 in the final.
South Korea's Lim Jong-hoon and Shin Yu-bin won mixed doubles bronze at the 2025 World Championships and won the mixed doubles title at the 2025 WTT Finals.
At the 2025 World Championships, doubles matches were best of five games and seeding used combined pair rankings.
In a Wikipedia-compiled ITTF ranking dated September 2026, Wang Chuqin was listed as world No. 1 in men's singles; Sun Yingsha was listed as No. 1 in women's singles in a July 2026 ranking.
Wang Chuqin won the men's singles world title in Doha in 2025 and the 2026 ITTF World Cup in Macao.
This session opens singles with the round of 64, and singles is single elimination through to the medal matches.

facts: Table tennis at the 2028 Games runs at the Los Angeles Convention Center, Hall 3, and that hall is also set to host para table tennis.
Table tennis play is scheduled over 15 days, from Saturday July 15 to Saturday July 29, 2028.
The 2028 program has six events: men's and women's singles, men's and women's doubles, mixed doubles, and a first-ever mixed team event.

In the ITTF men's singles ranking of October 26, 2026, Japan's Sora Matsushima was world No. 1, ahead of France's Felix Lebrun (No. 2), Japan's Tomokazu Harimoto (No. 3), Sweden's Truls Moregard (No. 4), and China's Wang Chuqin (No. 5).
In August 2026, at 19 years, 5 months and 6 days old, Sora Matsushima became the youngest man ever ranked world No. 1 in singles.
The rest of the October 2026 men's top 10 was Lin Yun-Ju of Chinese Taipei (6), Brazil's Hugo Calderano (7), France's Alexis Lebrun (8), China's Lin Shidong (9), and South Korea's Jang Woojin (10).
China's Sun Yingsha won women's singles at the 2025 World Championships in Doha, with Wang Manyu taking silver and Japan's Mima Ito a bronze.
Sun Yingsha won the 2026 World Cup women's singles title in Macau, and she was ranked world No. 2 in women's singles as of October 12, 2026.
After Paris 2024, Chen Meng indicated that Paris would be her last Games, so the women's singles champion is not expected to defend her title in 2028.
Fan Zhendong, the Paris 2024 men's singles champion, withdrew from the ITTF world rankings after Paris and has been playing club table tennis in the German Bundesliga.

facts: Men's doubles is back on the program for the first time since 2004, after team events replaced the doubles events starting at Beijing 2008.
The 2028 doubles draws start with a round of 16 and end with bronze and gold medal matches at the Los Angeles Convention Center, Hall 3.
No men's doubles was held at Paris 2024, so there is no defending champion; China won mixed doubles in Paris, North Korea took silver and South Korea took bronze.
Japan's Hiroto Shinozuka and Shunsuke Togami won men's doubles at the 2025 World Championships in Doha, entering as the second seeds.
Chinese Taipei's Lin Yun-ju and Kao Cheng-jui won silver in men's doubles at the 2025 World Championships.
Two French pairs won bronze in men's doubles at the 2025 World Championships: brothers Alexis and Felix Lebrun, and Esteban Dorr with Florian Bourrassaud.
In the October 2026 ITTF men's singles ranking, Felix Lebrun was No. 2 and Alexis Lebrun No. 8, and Japan's Togami (15) and Shinozuka (20) were also in the top 20.
China did not win the men's doubles title at the 2025 World Championships, so this event is one of China's less certain chances at a gold medal.

facts: This is the last round-of-32 singles session, at the Los Angeles Convention Center, Hall 3.
Sweden's Truls Moregard, the Paris 2024 men's singles silver medalist, won the inaugural WTT Europe Smash in Malmo in August 2025, beating then world No. 1 Lin Shidong 4-3 in the final.
That win made Moregard the first European player to win a WTT Grand Smash singles title.
Moregard won bronze in men's singles at the 2025 World Championships in Doha and was ranked world No. 4 in October 2026.
Japan's Tomokazu Harimoto beat Moregard 4-2 at the 2025 WTT Finals in Hong Kong and became the first Japanese player to win the WTT Finals men's singles title.
China's Wang Chuqin won men's singles at the 2025 World Championships, with Brazil's Hugo Calderano taking silver and China's Liang Jingkun a bronze.
Hugo Calderano was ranked world No. 7 in men's singles in October 2026.
China's Wang Manyu won the 2025 WTT Finals women's singles title.

facts: The first men's and women's singles quarterfinal session is at the Los Angeles Convention Center, Hall 3.
At Paris 2024, Fan Zhendong (China) won men's singles gold, Truls Moregardh (Sweden) took silver and Felix Lebrun (France) took bronze.
At Paris 2024, Chen Meng (China) won women's singles gold, Sun Yingsha (China) took silver and Hina Hayata (Japan) took bronze.

Chen Meng indicated after Paris 2024 that it would be her last Games, and Fan Zhendong withdrew from the ITTF world rankings after Paris, so neither Paris singles champion is expected to defend in 2028.
Fan Zhendong led 1. FC Saarbrucken to the German league title in May 2026, completing a domestic treble, before signing a one-year deal with Borussia Dusseldorf for 2026-27.
Fan Zhendong has not publicly confirmed whether he will compete at the 2028 Games.
China's Wang Chuqin, the 2025 world men's singles champion, was ranked world No. 5 in October 2026.
Sun Yingsha, the Paris 2024 women's singles silver medalist, won the 2025 world singles title and was ranked world No. 2 in October 2026.

facts: The 2028 Games singles draws start at a round of 64 and are single-elimination, so the quarterfinal round has eight players in each of the men's and women's draws.
Under the qualification system released in February 2026, each national federation may enter at most two players in each singles event.
China's Wang Chuqin won his first world men's singles title at the 2025 World Championships in Doha, beating Brazil's Hugo Calderano 4-1 in the final.
At the 2025 World Championships, Liang Jingkun (China) and Truls Möregårdh (Sweden) won the men's singles bronze medals, while top seed Lin Shidong (China) went out in the quarterfinals.
Félix Lebrun of France, the Paris 2024 men's singles bronze medalist, was seeded sixth at the 2025 World Championships and lost in the fourth round.
Japan's Tomokazu Harimoto was seeded fourth at the 2025 World Championships and went out in the third round.
Sun Yingsha (China) won her second straight world women's singles title in Doha in 2025, beating Wang Manyu 4-3 in the final; Mima Ito (Japan) and Chen Xingtong (China) took bronze.
Sun Yingsha also won the 2025 World Cup women's singles title in Macau.
Paris 2024 champions Fan Zhendong and Chen Meng withdrew from the ITTF world rankings in December 2024, and neither had played an international event since Paris at the time.
ITTF President Petra Sörling said in December 2025 that she could see Fan Zhendong competing at the 2028 Games, but he would not get an easy route back after leaving the rankings.
Fan Zhendong won the singles gold at China's National Games in 2025, and he has since played club table tennis in the German Bundesliga.

facts: This session has the men's singles bronze medal match and gold medal match.
Fan Zhendong won the Paris 2024 men's singles gold over Sweden's Truls Möregårdh, and France's Félix Lebrun took bronze.
Fan Zhendong withdrew from the ITTF world rankings in December 2024, though he said he was not retiring.
Fan Zhendong won National Games singles gold in 2025, and ITTF President Petra Sörling said in December 2025 that she could see him playing at the 2028 Games.
Fan Zhendong has said in interviews that he has not yet decided on the 2028 Games and would leave it up to time.
Wang Chuqin won the 2025 world men's singles title in Doha, beating Hugo Calderano 4-1, and also won the world mixed doubles title with Sun Yingsha.
Brazil's Hugo Calderano reached the 2025 world men's singles final and beat Wang Chuqin in the 2025 World Cup semifinals.
Truls Möregårdh won bronze at the 2025 World Championships after his Paris 2024 silver.
A medal for Calderano, Möregårdh or Lebrun would extend the non-Chinese podium finishes that Möregårdh and Lebrun achieved in Paris.

facts: The mixed team event makes its debut at the 2028 Games and replaces the separate men's and women's team events used from Beijing 2008 through Paris 2024.
The IOC Executive Board approved the mixed team event in April 2025, which brought table tennis to six medal events, more than any other racket sport at the 2028 Games.
The mixed team format was first used at the ITTF Mixed Team World Cup in Chengdu in December 2023.
At the 2028 Games the mixed team event starts with a group stage of four groups, followed by quarterfinals, semifinals and the bronze and gold medal matches.

At the Mixed Team World Cup, ties are played as a series of doubles and singles matches with games counted cumulatively, and the lower-ranked team's captain chooses whether men's or women's doubles is played first in the closing doubles matches.
China won the 2025 Mixed Team World Cup in Chengdu with an 8-1 final win over Japan, its third straight title, and no other team has won the event since 2023.
The 2025 Mixed Team World Cup had 16 teams, and ranking points for the winner rose from 1,000 to 2,500.
Qualification for the mixed team event runs through continental and world pathways during 2027-2028, with team rankings from May 2028 used for team events.

The 2028 mixed team event has four groups, and the leading teams move on to the quarterfinals.
China won all three Mixed Team World Cups held since the format began in 2023, including an 8-1 win over Japan in the 2025 final in Chengdu.
Japan was runner-up at the 2025 Mixed Team World Cup, and its mixed doubles pair Sora Matsushima and Satsuki Odo lost the opening doubles of the final 11-4, 11-4, 11-6.
China's lineup at the 2025 Mixed Team World Cup included Wang Chuqin, Sun Yingsha, Wang Manyu and Lin Shidong.
At the 2025 Mixed Team World Cup, Wang Chuqin and Sun Yingsha were the world No. 1-ranked mixed doubles pair.
At Paris 2024, Sweden and France won men's team silver and bronze and Japan and Korea won women's team silver and bronze, so they are possible mixed team contenders depending on qualification.

facts: The mixed team event makes its Games debut in Los Angeles, and per the ITTF qualification system it is one of six table tennis medal events at the 2028 Games, the most in the sport's history.
The ITTF says 172 table tennis athletes, split equally between men and women, will compete at the 2028 Games.
Each qualified mixed team has three men and three women, according to the ITTF qualification system document.

Of the 16 mixed teams, five qualify as continental champions, six through the 2027 ITTF Mixed Team World Cup, two through the January 2028 Mixed Team World Ranking, one as host (USA), and two through players already qualified in singles, doubles or mixed doubles.
At the 2027 European Games in Istanbul, 16 mixed teams will compete and the gold medalist takes Europe's continental quota place for the 2028 Games.

Great Britain enters the Mixed Team world rankings as a single team, the only ranking list where the ITTF recognises GB instead of the individual Home Nations; it was eighth on the European Mixed Team Ranking as of August 2026.
Mixed team ties are a race to 8 games, played over three-game sets in this order: mixed doubles, women's singles, men's singles, men's doubles, women's doubles.
In 2025 the ITTF Mixed Team World Cup in Chengdu also opened with 16 teams split into four round-robin groups.
At the 2025 Mixed Team World Cup, France beat Japan in Stage 2 after Felix Lebrun beat Tomokazu Harimoto 3-0 and teamed with brother Alexis to win the men's doubles set.
Croatia had a breakthrough run into the late group rounds of the 2025 Mixed Team World Cup before Korea Republic eliminated them.
Group-stage results matter for seeding and bracket paths into the 2028 quarterfinals, which begin the next day.

facts: This is the first-ever gold medal match in the Games mixed team table tennis event.
China won all five table tennis gold medals at Paris 2024, including both team events and mixed doubles.
China won the 2025 ITTF Mixed Team World Cup in Chengdu, beating Japan 8-1 in the final on December 7, 2025, for a third straight title; no other team has won the event since it began in 2023.
In the 2025 final, Wang Chuqin and Sun Yingsha, the world No. 1 mixed doubles pair, beat Matsushima Sora and Odo Satsuki 11-4, 11-4, 11-6.
Sun Yingsha finished the 2025 Mixed Team World Cup without losing a game, winning 21 games across seven three-game matches in mixed doubles and women's singles.
China beat Japan in both the men's and women's finals at the 2026 World Team Championships in London; the men won a 12th straight world team title and the women a record 24th title.
In the 2026 women's world team final, Wang Manyu beat Hina Hayata 11-7, 11-7, 11-5 in the deciding rubber, China's sixth straight final win over Japan at the event.
China's 2026 world team men's roster was Wang Chuqin, Lin Shidong, Liang Jingkun, Xiang Peng and Zhou Qihao.
Japan's 2026 world team men's roster was Tomokazu Harimoto, Sora Matsushima, Shunsuke Togami, Yukiya Uda and Hiroto Shinozuka.
Ma Long, Fan Zhendong and Chen Meng withdrew from the ITTF world rankings on December 31, 2024, so it is unclear whether any of them will play at the 2028 Games.
Mixed team ties are a race to 8 games, played over three-game sets in this order: mixed doubles, women's singles, men's singles, men's doubles, women's doubles.

Under the FIVB qualification system confirmed in December 2025, 48 beach volleyball teams qualify for the 2028 Games: 24 men's and 24 women's.
As host nation, the USA has one guaranteed quota place per gender in beach volleyball and can pursue a second through the standard qualification pathways.
No 2028 rosters are confirmed, and pool draws for the preliminary round have not been announced.
At Paris 2024, Sweden won men's gold, Germany took silver and Norway took bronze.
At Paris 2024, Brazil (Ana Patricia/Duda) won women's gold, beating Canada's Brandie Wilkerson and Melissa Humana-Paredes in three sets, and Switzerland took bronze.
Paris 2024 champions David Ahman and Jonatan Hellvig of Sweden won the 2025 world title in Adelaide, beating compatriots Jacob Holting Nilsson and Elmer Andersson in an all-Swedish final.

Paris 2024 women's champions Ana Patricia and Duda of Brazil returned to the Beach Pro Tour in March 2025 after more than seven months away, and took bronze at the 2025 Brasilia and Montreal Elite events.

Southern California natives Kelly Cheng, a world champion who has played at two Games, and Megan Kraft, her former USC teammate, announced a new partnership in January 2026 aimed at qualifying for the 2028 Games.

facts: Beach volleyball at the 2028 Games will be played at Alamitos Beach Stadium in Long Beach, a venue organizers confirmed in April 2025.
Organizers moved beach volleyball to Long Beach's Alamitos Beach after negotiations with Santa Monica, the originally expected host, broke down.
Each 2028 tournament opens with pool-play preliminaries before a single-elimination bracket starting at the round of 16.
Under the FIVB qualification system confirmed in December 2025, 48 beach volleyball teams qualify for the 2028 Games: 24 men's and 24 women's.
Paris 2024 champions David Ahman and Jonatan Hellvig of Sweden won the 2025 world title in Adelaide, beating compatriots Jacob Holting Nilsson and Elmer Andersson in an all-Swedish final.
Ahman and Hellvig became the first men's pair to reach two consecutive World Championship finals after taking silver at the 2023 edition in Mexico.
Volleyball World described Holting Nilsson and Andersson as leaders of the men's FIVB world ranking in August 2026.

Latvia's Tina Graudina and Anastasija Samoilova won the 2025 women's world title in Adelaide, with Americans Kristen Nuss and Taryn Brasher taking silver and Brazil's Carol Solberg and Rebecca taking bronze.
No 2028 rosters are confirmed, and pool draws for the preliminary round have not been announced.

facts: Beach volleyball at the 2028 Games will be played at Alamitos Beach Stadium in Long Beach, a venue organizers confirmed in April 2025.
The volleyball and beach volleyball tournaments at the 2028 Games are scheduled to run from July 15 to 30, 2028.
Each 2028 tournament opens with pool-play preliminaries before a single-elimination bracket starting at the round of 16.
Five quota places per gender go to winners of the 2026 continental championships or Continental Tour Finals, the first qualification pathway for the 2028 Games.
The 2026 European Championships in Stare Jablonki, Poland, held in August 2026, were the first event to award quota places for the 2028 beach tournament.
FIVB reported that Australia's Mark Nicolaidis/Izac Carracher and Stefanie Fejes/Taliqua Clancy won Asian continental titles in 2026 and earned quota places for the 2028 Games.
FIVB reported in September 2026 that two Brazilian pairs had earned quota places for the 2028 Games through continental qualification.
Norway's Anders Mol and Christian Sorum, Paris 2024 bronze medalists, won 2025 Beach Pro Tour Elite events in Saquarema and Montreal and led the FIVB world ranking during the 2025 season.
Mol and Sorum beat Ahman and Hellvig in the 2025 Saquarema Elite final in Brazil.
No 2028 rosters are confirmed, and pool draws for the preliminary round have not been announced.

facts: Beach volleyball at the 2028 Games will be played at Alamitos Beach Stadium in Long Beach, a venue organizers confirmed in April 2025.
Each 2028 tournament opens with pool-play preliminaries before a single-elimination bracket starting at the round of 16.
At Paris 2024, Sweden won men's gold, Germany took silver and Norway took bronze.

Paris 2024 silver medalists Nils Ehlers and Clemens Wickler of Germany finished fourth at the 2025 World Championships after a semifinal loss to Ahman/Hellvig and a bronze-match loss to France's Teo Rotar and Arnaud Gauthier-Rat.
At the 2025 World Championships, Ehlers and Wickler beat Norway's Anders Mol and Christian Sorum 16-14 in the third set of their round-of-16 match.
Paris 2024 champions David Ahman and Jonatan Hellvig of Sweden won the 2025 world title in Adelaide, beating compatriots Jacob Holting Nilsson and Elmer Andersson in an all-Swedish final.
Norway's Anders Mol and Christian Sorum, Paris 2024 bronze medalists, won 2025 Beach Pro Tour Elite events in Saquarema and Montreal and led the FIVB world ranking during the 2025 season.
The 2027 FIVB Beach Volleyball World Championships in the Netherlands will award one quota place per gender to the winning teams, with a limit of two quota places per country.
No 2028 rosters are confirmed, and pool draws for the preliminary round have not been announced.

Paris 2024 women's champions Ana Patricia and Duda of Brazil returned to the Beach Pro Tour in March 2025 after more than seven months away, and took bronze at the 2025 Brasilia and Montreal Elite events.
Ana Patricia and Duda reached the semifinals of the October 2025 Newport Beach Elite in Southern California, their fifth straight Beach Pro Tour semifinal.
Ana Patricia and Duda won Brazil's 2025 domestic circuit season title with 10,080 points.
FIVB reported in September 2026 that two Brazilian pairs had earned quota places for the 2028 Games through continental qualification.

Latvia's Tina Graudina and Anastasija Samoilova won the 2025 women's world title in Adelaide, with Americans Kristen Nuss and Taryn Brasher taking silver and Brazil's Carol Solberg and Rebecca taking bronze.
No 2028 rosters are confirmed, and pool draws for the preliminary round have not been announced.

facts: Beach volleyball at the 2028 Games will be played at Alamitos Beach Stadium in Long Beach, a venue organizers confirmed in April 2025.
Each 2028 tournament opens with pool-play preliminaries before a single-elimination bracket starting at the round of 16.
Under the FIVB qualification system confirmed in December 2025, 48 beach volleyball teams qualify for the 2028 Games: 24 men's and 24 women's.
Five quota places per gender go to winners of the 2026 continental championships or Continental Tour Finals, the first qualification pathway for the 2028 Games.
The 2027 FIVB Beach Volleyball World Championships in the Netherlands will award one quota place per gender to the winning teams, with a limit of two quota places per country.
The 2026 NORCECA Beach Volleyball Championship, a continental qualifier, was scheduled for November 4-9 in Vega Baja, Puerto Rico, with 16 teams per gender.
As host nation, the USA has one guaranteed quota place per gender in beach volleyball and can pursue a second through the standard qualification pathways.
FIVB reported that Australia's Mark Nicolaidis/Izac Carracher and Stefanie Fejes/Taliqua Clancy won Asian continental titles in 2026 and earned quota places for the 2028 Games.
The 2026 European Championships in Stare Jablonki, Poland, held in August 2026, were the first event to award quota places for the 2028 beach tournament.
No 2028 rosters are confirmed, and pool draws for the preliminary round have not been announced.

Ana Patricia and Duda won Brazil's 2025 domestic circuit season title with 10,080 points.
No 2028 rosters are confirmed, and pool draws for the preliminary round have not been announced.

facts: Beach volleyball at the 2028 Games will be played at Alamitos Beach Stadium in Long Beach, a venue organizers confirmed in April 2025.
Each 2028 tournament opens with pool-play preliminaries before a single-elimination bracket starting at the round of 16.
Under the FIVB qualification system confirmed in December 2025, 48 beach volleyball teams qualify for the 2028 Games: 24 men's and 24 women's.
Ahman and Hellvig became the first men's pair to reach two consecutive World Championship finals after taking silver at the 2023 edition in Mexico.

Paris 2024 silver medalists Nils Ehlers and Clemens Wickler of Germany finished fourth at the 2025 World Championships after a semifinal loss to Ahman/Hellvig and a bronze-match loss to France's Teo Rotar and Arnaud Gauthier-Rat.
Norway's Anders Mol and Christian Sorum, Paris 2024 bronze medalists, won 2025 Beach Pro Tour Elite events in Saquarema and Montreal and led the FIVB world ranking during the 2025 season.
Ana Patricia and Duda reached the semifinals of the October 2025 Newport Beach Elite in Southern California, their fifth straight Beach Pro Tour semifinal.

Latvia's Tina Graudina and Anastasija Samoilova won the 2025 women's world title in Adelaide, with Americans Kristen Nuss and Taryn Brasher taking silver and Brazil's Carol Solberg and Rebecca taking bronze.
The 2027 FIVB Beach Volleyball World Championships in the Netherlands will award one quota place per gender to the winning teams, with a limit of two quota places per country.
No 2028 rosters are confirmed, and pool draws for the preliminary round have not been announced.

facts: The 2028 Games beach volleyball program has two medal events, a men's and a women's two-person team tournament, with 24 teams in each under the FIVB qualification system announced in December 2025.
Each tournament opens with pool-play preliminaries before a single-elimination bracket starting at the Round of 16; this session is an evening preliminary session at Alamitos Beach Stadium.
No 2028 rosters have been confirmed; qualification is ongoing.
Sweden's David Ahman and Jonatan Hellvig, the Paris 2024 men's champions, won the 2025 FIVB World Championship in Adelaide in November 2025.
Ahman and Hellvig became the youngest beach volleyball world champions ever at ages 23 and 24, according to Games-organizer coverage of the Adelaide final.
Ahman said after the 2025 world title that the pair had not expected to win in Adelaide because he had been injured.
Brazil's Ana Patricia and Duda, the Paris 2024 women's champions, lost in the Round of 16 at the 2025 World Championship to Americans Donlin and Denaburg, 2-0.
Latvia's Tina Graudina and Anastasija Samoilova won the 2025 women's world title, beating Americans Kristen Nuss and Taryn Brasher 21-15, 15-21, 15-11 in the final.
Latvia's 2025 title was the country's first men's or women's podium finish at a beach volleyball World Championship.
The U.S. teams will play at home in Southern California, where the sport is deeply rooted.

facts: Beach volleyball at the 2028 Games will be held at Alamitos Beach in Long Beach, a site announced in 2025 after Santa Monica was dropped as the planned venue.
Long Beach is set to host at least 11 sports during the 2028 Games, more than any venue city other than Los Angeles.
Under the FIVB qualification system announced December 11, 2025, 48 teams (24 men's and 24 women's) will qualify for the 2028 beach volleyball tournaments.
The USA, as host nation, gets one guaranteed quota place per gender and can earn a second through the standard qualification pathways.

Quota places come from the 2026 Continental Championships or Continental Tour Finals, the 2027 World Championships in the Netherlands (one place per gender for the winners), and the ranking list, which closes in 2028 and provides most of the places.
Sweden's Jacob Holting Nilsson and Elmer Andersson won the 2026 CEV EuroBeachVolley men's title over Norway's Anders Mol and Christian Sorum, earning Sweden a 2028 quota place.
The Netherlands' Schoon and Stam won the 2026 European women's title, securing a Dutch women's quota place.
Australia won both 2026 AVC Continental Championship titles in Shangluo, China: Mark Nicolaidis and Izac Carracher for the men and Stefanie Fejes and Taliqua Clancy for the women.

Morocco's men (Zouheir Elgraoui and Soufiane El Gharouti) and Nigeria's women (Esther Onyinye Mbah and Pamela Miyoum Bawa) won the 2026 CAVB African titles, making them the first African beach volleyball teams to earn quotas for the Games.
At the 2025 World Championships in Adelaide, the quarterfinals included an all-American match between Kristen Nuss/Taryn Brasher and Julia Donlin/Lexy Denaburg.
As of late 2026, no team rosters for the 2028 Games have been finalized, so Round of 16 matchups are unknown.

facts: Quarterfinal matches at the 2028 Games will be played at Alamitos Beach Stadium in Long Beach, California.
At Paris 2024, Sweden won the men's gold, Germany took silver and Norway took bronze, while Brazil won the women's gold, Canada took silver and Switzerland took bronze.
Sweden's David Ahman and Jonatan Hellvig won the 2025 World Championship in Adelaide, Sweden's first world title in either gender.

At the 2025 Worlds, Sweden's Jacob Holting Nilsson and Elmer Andersson took men's silver, France's Teo Rotar and Arnaud Gauthier-Rat won bronze, and Germany's Nils Ehlers and Clemens Wickler finished fourth.
Latvia's Tina Graudina and Anastasija Samoilova won the 2025 women's world title, beating Kristen Nuss and Taryn Brasher of the USA 2-1 in the final.
Brazil's Carolina Solberg and Rebecca Cavalcante won women's bronze at the 2025 Worlds, and Brazil's Thamela Coradello and Victoria Lopes finished fourth.
Paris 2024 champions Ana Patricia and Duda withdrew from the 2025 World Championships for medical reasons, according to the Brazilian federation.
The USA has one guaranteed quota place per gender for the 2028 Games as host nation.

The Newport Beach event was Ana Patricia and Duda's fifth straight Beach Pro Tour semifinal.
In November 2025, Duda announced a career break for mental-health reasons, Brazilian outlet Lance reported.
As of late 2026, it has not been confirmed whether Ana Patricia and Duda will compete together at the 2028 Games.
American pair Kristen Nuss and Taryn Brasher took silver at the 2025 World Championships.
Latvia's Graudina and Samoilova, the 2025 world champions, reached the quarterfinals of the 2026 European Championship in Stare Jablonki, Poland.
The USA has one guaranteed quota place per gender for the 2028 Games and can earn a second.

At Paris 2024, Sweden's Ahman and Hellvig won gold by beating Germany's Ehlers and Wickler 21-10, 21-13 in the final, and Norway took bronze.
Ahman and Hellvig won the 2025 world title in Adelaide, where fellow Swedes Nilsson and Andersson took silver, giving Sweden two medals at the championship.
Sweden had won only one World Championship medal before 2025, a silver for Ahman and Hellvig.
Latvia's Graudina and Samoilova beat Nuss and Brasher of the USA 2-1 in the 2025 women's world final, their first world title together.
Brazil's Carolina Solberg and Rebecca Cavalcante won the women's bronze match at the 2025 Worlds against fellow Brazilians Thamela and Victoria.
Semifinal matchups for the 2028 Games are unknown; most quota places will be decided by the ranking list, which closes in 2028.

At Paris 2024, Brazil's Ana Patricia and Duda won gold by beating Canada's Brandie Wilkerson and Melissa Humana-Paredes 26-24, 12-21, 15-10, and Switzerland won bronze.
The Paris 2024 women's final was the first women's final in the sport's history at the Games to go to three sets, and the win was Brazil's first women's title since 1996.
Ana Patricia and Duda withdrew from the 2025 World Championships for medical reasons, and Duda later announced a mental-health break, according to Lance.
As of late 2026, whether Ana Patricia and Duda will defend their title together at the 2028 Games has not been confirmed.
Latvia's Tina Graudina and Anastasija Samoilova are the reigning world champions after beating the USA's Kristen Nuss and Taryn Brasher 2-1 in the 2025 final in Adelaide.
Brazil's Carolina Solberg and Rebecca Cavalcante won bronze at the 2025 Worlds.
The USA has a guaranteed women's quota place as host nation, and the women's final will be played in Southern California, where the sport is deeply rooted.
The Netherlands (Schoon/Stam), Australia (Fejes/Clancy) and Nigeria (Mbah/Bawa) earned women's quota places by winning 2026 continental titles.

facts: The men's bronze and gold medal matches close the beach volleyball program at Alamitos Beach Stadium in Long Beach.
At Paris 2024, Sweden's David Ahman and Jonatan Hellvig, the top seeds, beat Germany's Nils Ehlers and Clemens Wickler 21-10, 21-13 for Sweden's first gold in the sport, and Norway won bronze.
Ahman and Hellvig added the 2025 world title in Adelaide, Sweden's first world title in either gender.
In 2026, Ahman and Hellvig won the Joao Pessoa Elite16 and a third straight Ostrava Elite16, bringing their career Tour medal count to 13 gold, five silver and two bronze.
Sweden's Jacob Holting Nilsson and Elmer Andersson took 2025 world silver and won the 2026 European title, earning Sweden a men's quota place for the 2028 Games.
Each country can have at most two quota places per gender, so Sweden could send two men's teams.
Norway's Anders Mol and Christian Sorum, the Paris 2024 bronze medalists, were runners-up at the 2026 European Championship.
Germany's Ehlers and Wickler finished fourth at the 2025 Worlds, and France's Rotar and Gauthier-Rat took bronze.
The USA has a guaranteed men's quota place as host nation; American pair Taylor Crabb and Andrew Benesh won bronze at the 2026 Ostrava Elite16.

facts: This session falls on July 15, 2028, the opening day of the indoor volleyball program at the 2028 Games.
France won the Paris 2024 men's gold, Poland took silver and the United States took bronze.
Italy won the 2025 FIVB Men's World Championship, beating Bulgaria 3-1 in the final on September 28, 2025, in Pasay, Philippines, before 16,429 fans.
At the 2025 Men's World Championship, Poland finished third, the Czech Republic fourth and the United States fifth.
Paris 2024 champion France finished 18th and Brazil 17th at the 2025 Men's World Championship.
Italy's 2025 men's world title roster was captained by setter Simone Giannelli and included Alessandro Michieletto and libero Fabio Balaso.
Early in the 2025 VNL season, Poland led the FIVB men's world ranking ahead of France, Slovenia, Japan, Italy and the United States.
The 2027 FIVB Men's World Championship, a qualifying pathway for the 2028 Games, will be held in Poland.

Under the qualification system confirmed by the FIVB in December 2025, the USA receives one guaranteed host quota place per gender, with remaining spots allocated via 2026 Continental Championships, the 2027 World Championships (top three not-yet-qualified teams per gender) and the FIVB World Ranking (three spots per gender) at the close of the VNL 2028 preliminary phase.
All preliminary, quarterfinal and medal-round indoor volleyball matches at the 2028 Games will be played at Honda Center in Anaheim, with volleyball contested from July 15 to July 30, 2028.
Honda Center, home of the NHL's Anaheim Ducks, seats roughly 18,000 to 18,600 spectators for indoor volleyball.
Anaheim has served as a training base for the U.S. men's and women's national volleyball teams since 2006.

facts: This men's preliminary session is part of the opening day (July 15) of indoor volleyball at the 2028 Games.
France won the Paris 2024 men's gold, Poland took silver and the United States took bronze.
Italy won the 2025 FIVB Men's World Championship, beating Bulgaria 3-1 in the final on September 28, 2025, in Pasay, Philippines, before 16,429 fans.
At the 2025 Men's World Championship, Poland finished third, the Czech Republic fourth and the United States fifth.
Paris 2024 champion France finished 18th and Brazil 17th at the 2025 Men's World Championship.
Italy's 2025 men's world title roster was captained by setter Simone Giannelli and included Alessandro Michieletto and libero Fabio Balaso.
Early in the 2025 VNL season, Poland led the FIVB men's world ranking ahead of France, Slovenia, Japan, Italy and the United States.
The 2027 FIVB Men's World Championship, a qualifying pathway for the 2028 Games, will be held in Poland.

Under the qualification system confirmed by the FIVB in December 2025, the USA receives one guaranteed host quota place per gender, with remaining spots allocated via 2026 Continental Championships, the 2027 World Championships (top three not-yet-qualified teams per gender) and the FIVB World Ranking (three spots per gender) at the close of the VNL 2028 preliminary phase.
All preliminary, quarterfinal and medal-round indoor volleyball matches at the 2028 Games will be played at Honda Center in Anaheim, with volleyball contested from July 15 to July 30, 2028.
Honda Center, home of the NHL's Anaheim Ducks, seats roughly 18,000 to 18,600 spectators for indoor volleyball.
Anaheim has served as a training base for the U.S. men's and women's national volleyball teams since 2006.

facts: This is a women's preliminary session in the early days of the 2028 Games indoor tournament.
Italy won the Paris 2024 women's gold, the United States took silver and Brazil took bronze.
Italy won the 2025 FIVB Women's World Championship in Bangkok, beating Turkiye 3-2 (25-23, 13-25, 26-24, 19-25, 15-8) in the final on September 7, 2025.
Turkiye's Melissa Vargas scored 33 points in the 2025 Women's World Championship final, and the silver was Turkiye's best-ever world championship result.
Italy, coached by Julio Velasco, won the 2025 Women's VNL in Lodz, Poland, defeating Brazil in the final, with Poland third and Japan fourth.
Italy libero Monica De Gennaro was named 2025 Women's VNL MVP and Alessia Orro was named best setter.
The United States women finished eighth at the 2025 Women's VNL.
Paola Egonu was part of Italy's 2025 VNL and World Championship title teams and captained club side Vero Volley Milano in 2026.
The 2027 FIVB Women's World Championship, a qualifying pathway for the 2028 Games, will be jointly staged by the USA and Canada.

Under the qualification system confirmed by the FIVB in December 2025, the USA receives one guaranteed host quota place per gender, with remaining spots allocated via 2026 Continental Championships, the 2027 World Championships (top three not-yet-qualified teams per gender) and the FIVB World Ranking (three spots per gender) at the close of the VNL 2028 preliminary phase.
All preliminary, quarterfinal and medal-round indoor volleyball matches at the 2028 Games will be played at Honda Center in Anaheim, with volleyball contested from July 15 to July 30, 2028.
Honda Center, home of the NHL's Anaheim Ducks, seats roughly 18,000 to 18,600 spectators for indoor volleyball.

On 11 December 2025 the FIVB announced the qualification system for the 2028 Games volleyball tournaments.
Under the FIVB system, the last three places in each tournament go by FIVB World Ranking after the preliminary round of the 2028 Volleyball Nations League.
Each women's tournament has 12 teams, with the host United States holding one automatic place.
At Paris 2024, Italy won its first women's gold by sweeping the United States 3-0, and Brazil won bronze.

The 2025 title was Italy's third Nations League crown, and it kept the title it won in 2024.
Brazil's Gabriela Guimaraes and Italy's Myriam Sylla were named best outside hitters at the 2025 Women's Nations League.
Italy opposite Paola Egonu, MVP at Paris 2024, was born 18 December 1998 and captained Vero Volley Milano in 2026.
Egonu was still a starter for Milano in the Italian A1 league in October 2026.

facts: This session is the late women's preliminary-round match at Honda Center on the opening day of women's play.
The FIVB announced the 2028 Games volleyball qualification system on 11 December 2025, with the window running through June 2028.
The last three places in each tournament go by FIVB World Ranking after the 2028 Volleyball Nations League preliminary round.
The United States, Paris 2024 women's silver medalist, qualifies automatically as host.
Italy beat Brazil 3-1 in the 2025 Women's Volleyball Nations League final after dropping the first set 22-25.
The 2025 Women's Nations League final round was played in Lodz, Poland.
Italy has won three Women's Nations League titles, in 2022, 2024 and 2025.
In the 2022 Nations League, Italy beat Brazil for its first title, Serbia took third, and Paola Egonu was MVP.
Egonu holds the record for points in a single match, 45, set in a semifinal against China.
Egonu, born in 1998, will be 29 during the 2028 Games.

facts: At Paris 2024, Brazil won the women's bronze medal, Italy won gold, and the United States took silver.
Brazil won bronze at the 2025 FIVB Women's World Championship in Thailand, and Japan finished fourth.
The final standings of the 2025 Women's World Championship were Italy 1st, Turkey 2nd, Brazil 3rd, Japan 4th, United States 5th, Netherlands 6th, Poland 7th and France 8th.
Brazil reached the 2025 Volleyball Nations League final, where it lost 3-1 (22-25, 25-18, 25-22, 25-22) to Italy in Lodz, Poland.
The U.S. women lost to Turkey in four sets (25-14, 22-25, 25-14, 25-23 in Turkey's favor) in the 2025 World Championship quarterfinals in Bangkok.
Turkey's silver at the 2025 World Championship was its best-ever result at that event; it had previously finished fourth in 2010.
Turkey opposite Melissa Vargas scored 33 points in the 2025 World Championship final and was named the tournament's best opposite.
As host nation, the United States receives an automatic quota place in the women's tournament at the 2028 Games.
The 2027 FIVB Women's World Championship, which will be co-hosted by the USA and Canada, is one of the qualification events for the 2028 Games.
The last three quota places per gender go to the top-ranked teams not yet qualified in the FIVB World Ranking after the 2028 Volleyball Nations League preliminary phase.
All indoor volleyball matches at the 2028 Games, including the medal matches, will be played at Honda Center in Anaheim, California, which seats roughly 18,000 for volleyball.
Anaheim has been a training base for the U.S. men's and women's national volleyball teams since 2006.

facts: Italy won the women's gold at Paris 2024, its first title in the event, by sweeping the United States 3-0 in the final; Brazil won bronze.
Paola Egonu scored 22 points in the Paris 2024 final and was named tournament MVP.
Italy won the 2025 FIVB Women's World Championship, its second world title, by beating Turkey 3-2 (25-23, 13-25, 26-24, 19-25, 15-8) in Bangkok on September 7, 2025.
Italy setter Alessia Orro was named MVP of the 2025 World Championship.
Egonu scored 22 points in the 2025 World Championship final and Myriam Sylla added 19, while Turkey's Melissa Vargas led all scorers with 33.
Italy won the 2025 Volleyball Nations League, beating Brazil 3-1 in the final in Lodz; it was Italy's third VNL title in four years and tied the USA for the most women's VNL titles.
Libero Monica De Gennaro was named MVP of the 2025 Volleyball Nations League, and Egonu was named best opposite.
Italy went into the 2025 World Championship on a 30-match winning streak that began after it lost to Brazil in Ningbo in June 2024, during the 2024 Volleyball Nations League.
Italy's women are coached by Julio Velasco, and Turkey's are coached by Daniele Santarelli, who is also Italian.
The United States, Paris 2024 silver medalists, finished fifth at the 2025 World Championship after losing to Turkey in the quarterfinals.
As host nation, the United States qualifies automatically for the women's tournament at the 2028 Games.

The 2027 Women's World Championship, co-hosted by the USA and Canada, is a qualification event for the 2028 Games, and three more places will be awarded through the FIVB World Ranking after the 2028 VNL preliminary phase.
The women's gold medal match on July 30, 2028, will be played at Honda Center in Anaheim, which seats about 18,000 for volleyball.

The United States won gold at the previous three Games before Paris 2024 but did not reach the podium in Paris, and it qualifies automatically for the 2028 Games as host.

facts: Women's water polo at the 2028 Games will include 12 teams for the first time, up from 10 at Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024, matching the men's 12-team field.
The IOC Executive Board approved the expansion of the women's tournament to 12 teams in April 2025, after the IOC Programme Commission endorsed a World Aquatics recommendation.
Water polo will be held at the Long Beach Aquatics Center, with the women's competition scheduled from July 13 to July 23, 2028, according to Total Waterpolo.
Under the new format reported by Total Waterpolo, teams will be split into three groups of four instead of the previous two-group setup, which had five teams per group in the women's event.
The top two teams from each group plus the two best third-placed teams will advance to the quarterfinals.
As host nation, the United States qualifies automatically for the women's tournament.
Spain won Paris 2024 gold, beating Australia 11-9 in the final after winning every match; the Netherlands took bronze.
The United States, champions at the previous three Games, finished off the podium at Paris 2024.
The women's tournament started with six teams at Sydney 2000, grew to eight at Beijing 2008 and to ten at Tokyo 2020.

facts: The 2028 Games women's water polo tournament will feature 12 teams, up from 10 at Paris 2024, matching the 12-team men's field for the first time.
Water polo at the 2028 Games will be held at the Long Beach Aquatics Center, a temporary open-air facility built on the Long Beach Convention Center lot.
The City of Long Beach lists the water polo competition window as July 12-23, 2028, placing the women's quarterfinals late in the tournament schedule.
Spain won Paris 2024 women's gold unbeaten, defeating Australia 11-9 in the final, with the Netherlands taking bronze.
Greece won the 2025 World Aquatics Championships women's title in Singapore, its second world title, by defeating Hungary in the final.
Hungary lost to Greece in both the 2025 World Cup final and the 2025 World Championships final, then lost to the Netherlands in the 2026 European Championships final.
The Netherlands won the 2026 Women's European Championship in Funchal, Portugal, beating Hungary in the final on February 5, 2026, for its seventh European title.
Croatia's women recorded their highest-ever European Championships finish at Funchal 2026.

Each class is a single-elimination bracket, and wrestlers who lose to either finalist go into repechage for the two bronze medals.
Kenichiro Fumita of Japan won Greco-Roman 60kg gold at Paris 2024.

At the 2025 World Championships in Zagreb, Aidos Sultangali of Kazakhstan won Greco-Roman 60kg gold, Alisher Ganiev of Uzbekistan took silver, and Ri Se-ung of North Korea and Hrachya Poghosyan of Armenia took bronze.
Mijain Lopez of Cuba won Greco-Roman 130kg at Paris 2024 over Yasmani Acosta of Chile, his fifth straight title at the Games and a record for an individual event.
Amin Mirzazadeh of Iran won the 2025 world Greco-Roman 130kg title, beating Darius Vitek of Hungary 7-2 in the final; Elias Kuosmanen of Finland and Pavel Hlinchuk took bronze.
USA's Cohlton Schultz placed 16th in Greco-Roman 130kg at the 2025 World Championships, and Cuba's Oscar Pino placed 11th.
Sarah Hildebrandt of the USA won women's freestyle 50kg gold at Paris 2024 over Cuba's Yusneylys Guzman, after the original finalist was disqualified for missing weight.
Won Myong-gyong of North Korea won the 2025 world title in women's freestyle 50kg, with Zhang Yu of China taking silver and Elizaveta Smirnova and Evin Demirhan Yavuz of Turkey taking bronze.
Each nation may enter only one wrestler per weight class, and places are earned through United World Wrestling qualifying events.

facts: This session covers the round of 16 and quarterfinals in men's freestyle 65kg and 97kg and women's freestyle 76kg, plus repechage bouts for the classes that have medal matches later the same day.
Japan's Kotaro Kiyooka won the men's freestyle 65kg gold at Paris 2024.
Iran's Rahman Amouzad won the 65kg title at the 2025 World Championships in Zagreb, beating Kotaro Kiyooka in the final; Real Woods of the USA and Umidjon Jalolov of Uzbekistan took bronze.
The 2025 world 65kg bracket had 34 wrestlers from 32 nations, a sign of how deep the early rounds in this class can be.
Bahrain's Akhmed Tazhudinov won the men's freestyle 97kg gold at Paris 2024 and was the 2023 world champion at 97kg.
At the 2025 World Championships, Tazhudinov came close to losing in the 97kg quarterfinals against Magomed Kurbanov, who led 4-0 early, before Tazhudinov went on to take bronze.

Kyle Snyder of the USA won the 2025 world title at 97kg, his fourth world title, beating Iran's Amir Ali Azarpira 4-2 in the final; Azarpira had beaten Snyder 4-1 in the Paris 2024 bronze-medal match.
Abdulrashid Sadulaev, who won 97kg golds in 2016 and 2020 and five world titles, was ranked No. 2 at 97kg by FloWrestling going into the 2025 World Championships.
Japan's Yuka Kagami won the women's freestyle 76kg gold at Paris 2024, beating Kennedy Blades of the USA in the final.
Kennedy Blades was entered at 68kg, not 76kg, in the 2026 U.S. Final X series, and Kylie Welker was the U.S. entrant in the 76kg Final X matchup.

facts: This evening session has the semifinals in men's freestyle 65kg and 97kg and women's freestyle 76kg, followed by the bronze-medal matches and gold-medal finals in men's freestyle 74kg and 125kg and women's freestyle 68kg.
Uzbekistan's Razambek Zhamalov won the men's freestyle 74kg gold at Paris 2024.
Japan's Kota Takahashi won the 74kg title at the 2025 World Championships, with Albania's Chermen Valiev taking silver and Zaurbek Sidakov and Slovakia's Tajmuraz Salkazanov taking bronze.
Zaurbek Sidakov, the 2023 world champion at 74kg, came back from an injury in time for the 2025 World Championships and went on to take bronze.
Georgia's Geno Petriashvili won the men's freestyle 125kg gold at Paris 2024.
Iran's Amir Hossein Zare, the Paris 2024 silver medalist at 125kg, won his third world title in 2025 by beating Azerbaijan's Giorgi Meshvildishvili 5-0 in Zagreb.
Zare and Petriashvili have a long 125kg rivalry: Zare beat Petriashvili in the 2021 and 2023 world finals.
Gable Steveson of the USA, who won 125kg gold at Tokyo 2020, has said he would like to win gold at the 2028 Games in Los Angeles, but in 2026 he said his UFC career is now his priority.
Gable Steveson signed with Real American Freestyle wrestling in March 2026.
Amit Elor of the USA won the women's freestyle 68kg gold at Paris 2024 at age 20, becoming the youngest U.S. wrestling gold medalist at the Games.
Elor moved up to 72kg, a weight not contested at the Games, in 2025, then missed the 2025 World Championships because of anemia and injuries and announced in September 2025 that she was pregnant.
Elor came back three months after giving birth and won the 72kg U.S. World Team Trials Challenge tournament in May 2026, pinning Precious Wieser in the final.
Kennedy Blades, the Paris 2024 silver medalist at 76kg, was entered at 68kg in the 2026 U.S. Final X series against Isabella Mir.

facts: This session has the repechage bouts, both bronze-medal matches and the gold-medal finals in men's freestyle 65kg and 97kg and women's freestyle 76kg.
Each weight class awards two bronze medals, decided through a repechage for wrestlers who lost to the two finalists.
Japan's Kotaro Kiyooka won 65kg gold at Paris 2024, then took silver at the 2025 World Championships after losing the final to Iran's Rahman Amouzad.
Real Woods of the USA and Umidjon Jalolov of Uzbekistan won the 65kg bronze medals at the 2025 World Championships.
Bahrain's Akhmed Tazhudinov won 97kg gold at Paris 2024, and after winning the 2025 Ranking Series events in Budapest and Madrid he took bronze at the 2025 World Championships.

Kyle Snyder of the USA, the 2016 gold medalist at 97kg, won his fourth world title in 2025 by beating Iran's Amir Ali Azarpira 4-2 in the final, which made up for his 4-1 loss to Azarpira in the Paris 2024 bronze-medal match.
Japan's Arash Yoshida took bronze at 97kg at the 2025 World Championships.

In 2025, Snyder pleaded guilty to a disorderly conduct charge, and the U.S. Center for SafeSport suspended him temporarily before lifting the suspension a few days later, according to The Columbus Dispatch.
Snyder's 2025 world title capped a run in which U.S. men won three freestyle world titles in three days in Zagreb, with Zahid Valencia winning 86kg and Trent Hidlay winning 92kg.
Japan's Yuka Kagami won women's freestyle 76kg gold at Paris 2024, beating Kennedy Blades of the USA in the final.
Blades competed at 68kg rather than 76kg in the 2026 U.S. Final X series, where Kylie Welker was the U.S. 76kg entrant.
